method: every occurrence of the affected surface re-read; the rewrite output inspected directly rather than inferred from the match
reason:
Two defects an adversarial review found in batch 42, both mine.

First, a preferred label must be a LEMMA, and I took this one from a heading. `technical.material_information` shipped with pt-BR pref `Informações Relevantes` — plural, because that is how the section banner is printed — while all eight corpus occurrences are the singular `informação relevante`. The preferred label is what the canonical projection substitutes, so the concept rewrote its own only attested spelling into a form the corpus never uses, 8 times out of 8. The projection is a lemma projection with span mappings back to the source, so it is not required to emit publishable prose — but it IS required to emit the lemma, and `Informações Relevantes` is not the lemma of `informação relevante`. Renamed, with the plural kept as a form so the heading still resolves.

The review also reported this as part of a wider claim that the projection corrupts grammatical number generally, citing `os títulos de renda fixa` -> `Os Título de Renda Fixa`. That part is NOT accepted as a defect and no guard is added for it. Projecting a plural onto its singular lemma is what the field is for, and the same output shows `compra` -> `comprar`, an infinitive, which predates this batch and is the same intended behaviour. A blanket number-agreement guard would refuse most of the normalisation the tool exists to perform — the review asked for exactly the trade this campaign already made and recorded once, where a truncation guard blocked 149 legitimate rewrites to catch 24. The defect was the label, and the label is fixed.

Second, `technical.benchmark_relative_management` never fired on its own textbook definition. Its registered forms were the two heading spellings, so the sentence that defines it at 09-gestao-de-carteiras-de-renda-fixa-2 resolved to three unrelated atomic concepts. A concept whose forms match only its banner and not its definition is the circularity this batch claimed to be avoiding, so the prose wording is registered.

operations.why: The lemma, and the only spelling the corpus uses in all 8 occurrences. The previous pref was the plural heading spelling and rewrote every occurrence wrongly.
Restored as a form after the rename, which retires the old pref. It is a real surface — the section heading — it is simply not the lemma.

operations.form: Gestão de Carteiras de Renda Fixa em relação a um benchmark
operations.why: The wording of the defining sentence, lowercase `em relação`, no `RF` and no `Índice de Mercado`. Without it the concept matched its banner and not its definition.
